_comment: Row 334. Re-run from a detached scratch copy with toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row334_unavailable_health_measurements.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH. Six exact-once regressions restore the four reproduced fail-open health surfaces and the two boundary mappings made reachable by the fix. Every named catcher drives a runtime failure and requires UNKNOWN/non-green; the band also retains one measured-empty or measured-healthy control per surface. The separate transform-control battery applies every identical valid transform under only its paired healthy control and all six must ESCAPE.
